gloss: consistently; throughout; from start to finish

definitions.gloss: consistently; throughout; from start to finish
definitions.explanation: Without changing or wavering from beginning to end. Used to describe attitudes, policies, or actions that remain the same over time.

examples.japanese: {一貫|いっかん}して{反対|はんたい}している。
{彼|かれ}は{一貫|いっかん}して{自分|じぶん}の{主張|しゅちょう}を{貫|つらぬ}いた。
examples.english: He stuck to his position consistently.

examples.japanese: この{会社|かいしゃ}は{創業|そうぎょう}から{一貫|いっかん}して{品質|ひんしつ}{第一|だいいち}の{方針|ほうしん}を{守|まも}ってきた。
examples.english: This company has maintained a quality-first policy consistently since its founding.

notes:
USAGE:
{一貫|いっかん}して is the te-form of {一貫|いっかん}する, functioning as an adverb. It modifies verbs to emphasize that something has not changed over a period of time.

WORD FORMATION:
{一|いち} (one) + {貫|かん} (piercing through) — literally "piercing through as one," meaning unwavering.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一貫|いっかん}して{主張|しゅちょう}する: to consistently assert
- {一貫|いっかん}して{反対|はんたい}する: to consistently oppose
- {一貫|いっかん}した{態度|たいど}: a consistent attitude
- {一貫|いっかん}した{方針|ほうしん}: a consistent policy
